title: Tooth pain plus booking intent routes to urgent consultation
description: The caller asks to book a consultation because a tooth hurts and the doctor should see it. This should bypass the first-visit gate and use an urgent first-available lookup.

turns.user: Chciałbym się umówić na konsultację, bo ząb mnie boli, chciałem żeby lekarz to zobaczył.

rubric.description: Tooth pain with booking intent should trigger an immediate availability lookup.
rubric.root_cause_hint: urgent tooth-pain booking intent fell through to the first-visit gate

rubric.description: The lookup must use urgent_consultation instead of the standard consultation bucket.
rubric.root_cause_hint: tooth pain was routed as a normal first-visit consultation

rubric.description: When the urgent caller gives no date or hour, the assistant should check first_available.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant asked for first-visit details or time preference before checking urgent availability

rubric.description: The urgent tooth-pain request should not be blocked by asking whether this is the first visit.
rubric.root_cause_hint: first-visit gate still outranks urgent tooth-pain routing

rubric.description: The assistant must not create a booking before slot selection and confirmation.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant advanced into booking without explicit slot selection and confirmation
